paragraphs.en: Atlas is source control for coding agents. Every agent run produces checkpoints: commits are linked back to the session that made it alongside the prompts, tool calls, and reasoning. You see which agent did exactly what and why.
paragraphs.zh: Atlas 是面向智能体编程的源代码控制工具。 每次智能体运行都会生成检查点：提交会与产生它的会话关联，同时附带提示词、工具调用和推理过程。 你能看清每个智能体到底做了什么、为什么这么做。

sents.en: Atlas is source control for coding agents.
sents.zh: Atlas 是面向智能体编程的源代码控制工具。

sents.en: Every agent run produces checkpoints: commits are linked back to the session that made it alongside the prompts, tool calls, and reasoning.
sents.zh: 每次智能体运行都会生成检查点：提交会与产生它的会话关联，同时附带提示词、工具调用和推理过程。

sents.en: You see which agent did exactly what and why.
sents.zh: 你能看清每个智能体到底做了什么、为什么这么做。

paragraphs.en: Run Claude Code, Codex, Atlas's own agent, or anything from the ACP registry side by side against the same codebase, with shared memory so switching agents mid-task doesn't mean starting over.
paragraphs.zh: 并行运行 Claude Code、Codex、Atlas 自研的智能体，或来自 ACP 注册表的任何智能体，针对同一个代码库工作，并共享记忆，因此在任务中途切换智能体也无需从头开始。

paragraphs.en: Grab the latest build from tryatlas.cc or the releases page — a .dmg for macOS (Apple Silicon or Intel), an .msi for Windows.
paragraphs.zh: 请从 tryatlas.cc 或发布页面获取最新版本——macOS 的 .dmg 文件（支持 Apple Silicon 或 Intel），Windows 的 .msi 文件。

paragraphs.en: macOS 13+ and Windows 10+ (x64) are the supported platforms. Linux builds from the same Tauri codebase but is untested — see Build from source .
paragraphs.zh: 支持的平台为 macOS 13+ 和 Windows 10+ (x64)。 Linux 可基于相同的 Tauri 代码库构建，但未经测试——请参阅 Build from source。

sents.en: macOS 13+ and Windows 10+ (x64) are the supported platforms.
sents.zh: 支持的平台为 macOS 13+ 和 Windows 10+ (x64)。

paragraphs.en: Agents now write a large share of the code and keep none of the reasoning behind it. The prompt that produced a change, the tool calls it made, the approach it tried first and abandoned — all of it lives in a scrollback buffer until the buffer scrolls.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体如今编写了大量代码，却不保留其背后的任何推理过程。 促成某次修改的提示词、它调用的工具、它先尝试后又放弃的方案——这一切都只存在于回滚缓冲区里，直到缓冲区被滚走为止。

sents.en: Agents now write a large share of the code and keep none of the reasoning behind it.
sents.zh: 智能体如今编写了大量代码，却不保留其背后的任何推理过程。

sents.en: The prompt that produced a change, the tool calls it made, the approach it tried first and abandoned — all of it lives in a scrollback buffer until the buffer scrolls.
sents.zh: 促成某次修改的提示词、它调用的工具、它先尝试后又放弃的方案——这一切都只存在于回滚缓冲区里，直到缓冲区被滚走为止。

paragraphs.en: What survives is a commit message, written by a model, summarizing a diff. Months later that is the only record of why the code looks the way it does.
paragraphs.zh: 最终留存下来的是一条提交信息，由模型撰写，用以概括一个代码差异（diff）。 数月之后，那将成为解释代码为何呈现当前样貌的唯一记录。

paragraphs.en: Two commitments shape how Atlas answers them:
paragraphs.zh: 两个承诺决定了 Atlas 回答这些问题的方式：

paragraphs.en: A checkpoint is what a commit doesn't tell you on its own: which session produced it, what the agent was asked, the tool calls it made, and the reasoning behind the change, kept together instead of lost the moment the terminal scrolls.
paragraphs.zh: 检查点（checkpoint）所包含的，是提交（commit）本身无法告诉你的信息：它由哪个会话产生、智能体被要求做什么、它调用了哪些工具，以及变更背后的推理过程——这些都被保存在一起，而不是随着终端滚动而瞬间丢失。

paragraphs.en: Atlas records every agent session locally in .atlas/sessions.db , with secrets scrubbed before anything touches disk. When you commit (from any tool, even with Atlas closed), the commit is linked back to the session that produced it as a checkpoint, and links survive rebases and amends.
paragraphs.zh: Atlas 会将每个智能体会话本地记录在 .atlas/sessions.db 中，在任何内容写入磁盘之前都会先清除其中的机密信息。 当你提交代码时（无论使用哪个工具，甚至在 Atlas 关闭的情况下），该提交都会作为检查点链接回产生它的会话，并且这些链接在 rebase 和 amend 操作后依然保持有效。

sents.en: Atlas records every agent session locally in .atlas/sessions.db , with secrets scrubbed before anything touches disk.
sents.zh: Atlas 会将每个智能体会话本地记录在 .atlas/sessions.db 中，在任何内容写入磁盘之前都会先清除其中的机密信息。

sents.en: When you commit (from any tool, even with Atlas closed), the commit is linked back to the session that produced it as a checkpoint, and links survive rebases and amends.
sents.zh: 当你提交代码时（无论使用哪个工具，甚至在 Atlas 关闭的情况下），该提交都会作为检查点链接回产生它的会话，并且这些链接在 rebase 和 amend 操作后依然保持有效。

paragraphs.en: You don't have to read the raw transcript to get the context back: select a checkpoint and chat with it directly, and it answers from what actually happened in that session. Local mode works fully offline with no account.
paragraphs.zh: 你无需阅读原始记录就能找回上下文：选择一个检查点并直接与它对话，它会根据该会话中实际发生的内容来回答。 本地模式完全离线运行，无需账户。

sents.en: Local mode works fully offline with no account.
sents.zh: 本地模式完全离线运行，无需账户。

paragraphs.en: Atlas runs your agents as they are, and enriches what they see.
paragraphs.zh: Atlas 按原样运行你的智能体，并丰富它们所看到的内容。

paragraphs.en: Claude Code and Codex run as external subprocesses over ACP , the most-used, most-tested path. Atlas Agent, the native agent, runs in-process on its own engine, ported once from an Apache-2.0 project and maintained by Atlas (see CONTEXT.md , ADR-0003 and ADR-0011).
paragraphs.zh: Claude Code 和 Codex 作为外部子进程通过 ACP 运行，这是使用最多、测试最充分的路径。 Atlas Agent（原生智能体）在自身的引擎上以进程内方式运行，该引擎曾从 Apache-2.0 项目一次性移植而来，并由 Atlas 维护（参见 CONTEXT.md、ADR-0003 和 ADR-0011）。

sents.en: Claude Code and Codex run as external subprocesses over ACP , the most-used, most-tested path.
sents.zh: Claude Code 和 Codex 作为外部子进程通过 ACP 运行，这是使用最多、测试最充分的路径。

sents.en: Atlas Agent, the native agent, runs in-process on its own engine, ported once from an Apache-2.0 project and maintained by Atlas (see CONTEXT.md , ADR-0003 and ADR-0011).
sents.zh: Atlas Agent（原生智能体）在自身的引擎上以进程内方式运行，该引擎曾从 Apache-2.0 项目一次性移植而来，并由 Atlas 维护（参见 CONTEXT.md、ADR-0003 和 ADR-0011）。

paragraphs.en: Beyond those, Atlas can spawn any agent in the ACP registry (Cursor, OpenCode, Kilo Code, and more), pulling in each one's official binary automatically. All of them go through the same send path, so everything below applies whichever one you pick.
paragraphs.zh: 除此之外，Atlas 还可以启动 ACP 注册表中的任意智能体（Cursor、OpenCode、Kilo Code 等），并自动拉取各自的官方二进制文件。 它们都走相同的发送路径，因此无论你选择哪一个，下文内容均适用。

paragraphs.en: To use the Claude Code agent, install the claude CLI and put it on your PATH . Atlas's native agent needs no external CLI.
paragraphs.zh: 要使用 Claude Code 智能体，请安装 claude CLI 并将其添加到你的 PATH 中。 Atlas 的原生智能体无需外部 CLI。

sents.zh: 要使用 Claude Code 智能体，请安装 claude CLI 并将其添加到你的 PATH 中。

sents.en: Atlas's native agent needs no external CLI.
sents.zh: Atlas 的原生智能体无需外部 CLI。

paragraphs.en: Requires Bun and Rust (stable, via rustup ), plus Xcode Command Line Tools on macOS or the MSVC build tools (Visual Studio Build Tools with the C++ workload) on Windows.
paragraphs.zh: 需要 Bun 和 Rust（稳定版，通过 rustup 安装），此外在 macOS 上还需要 Xcode 命令行工具，或在 Windows 上需要 MSVC 构建工具（带有 C++ 工作负载的 Visual Studio Build Tools）。

paragraphs.en: sudo apt install -y libglib2.0-dev libgtk-3-dev libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev Fedora / RHEL : sudo dnf install glib2-devel gtk3-devel webkit2gtk4.1-devel Arch Linux / Manjaro : sudo pacman -S glib2 gtk3 webkit2gtk-4.1 openSUSE : sudo zypper install glib2-devel gtk3-devel webkit2gtk3-devel git clone https://github.com/pacifio/atlas cd atlas bun install bun run dev:app The first Rust compile takes a few minutes; after that it is seconds. Use bun run dev for frontend-only iteration, though anything calling invoke() needs dev:app .
paragraphs.zh: sudo apt install -y libglib2.0-dev libgtk-3-dev libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev Fedora / RHEL：sudo dnf install glib2-devel gtk3-devel webkit2gtk4.1-devel Arch Linux / Manjaro：sudo pacman -S glib2 gtk3 webkit2gtk-4.1 openSUSE：sudo zypper install glib2-devel gtk3-devel webkit2gtk3-devel git clone https://github.com/pacifio/atlas cd atlas bun install bun run dev:app 首次编译 Rust 需要几分钟，之后只需几秒钟。 使用 bun run dev 可以进行仅前端的迭代开发，但任何调用 invoke() 的代码都需要使用 dev:app。
